title: City of Ray City - RCPD Home
key_finding: Ray City's official police page describes the department as a full-service, full-time police department recognized by Georgia P.O.S.T., led by Chief Steve Miller, and staffed by two full-time plus three part-time officers.

title: City of Ray City - Map & Directions
key_finding: The city's contact page lists a dedicated Police Department phone number at city hall, which supports the existence of a current municipal police function.

title: Contact Directory - Berrien County GA
key_finding: Berrien County lists E-911 non-emergency at 229-686-2091 and separately lists the Sheriff Office at 229-686-7071; the Ray City police page uses the same 229-686-2091 number for after-hours calls, indicating county dispatch support rather than sheriff replacement of the city police department.

title: 2020 Comprehensive Plan Update
key_finding: The joint comprehensive plan for Berrien County and its cities states that Ray City became incorporated on August 16, 1909, confirming that Ray City is a real incorporated municipal government.

title: 2022 Municipal Government Information Catalog
key_finding: Georgia's municipal public-safety catalog includes Ray City in the police-related public-safety tables with nonblank police fields, corroborating that Ray City operates a city police function.

title: Crime Statistics
key_finding: GBI says Georgia UCR data is compiled directly from reports submitted by law-enforcement agencies and that additional UCR data can be retrieved for special-purpose reports upon request.

title: GBI Crime Statistics Database
key_finding: GBI states that the public crime-statistics database is not available at this time, which helps explain why agency-level continuity is not visible through the normal public database path.
